mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 73 degrees, and please note the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 61.

The City of Verona Plan Commission is meeting to discuss new development projects. Notable items include the site plan for 201 South Main Street and an initial review for the Sub-Zero project located at the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in our city, with trivia events happening today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by a full day tomorrow including the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga sessions, and trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

For our weekly report, we look back to Saturday, August 8, when Verona police assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office with a vehicle rollover. The driver fled the scene on foot but was located and detained for an O W I arrest.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch, which you can enjoy at the Verona location until they close at 10 PM tonight.
